title: Interview → IC Pathway: Decision Funnel & Mentor Curation Playbook
content:
Purpose:
This playbook bridges interview outcomes to a structured IC (individual contributor) onboarding path, with a lightweight decision funnel for offer/no-offer/hold, an evidence-driven interview rubric, and a mentor curation process that seeds the first 30/60/90 impact plan. Goal: reduce time-to-productivity for new ICs and make hiring decisions auditable and consistent across teams.

Summary of flow (one line):
Candidate screen -> evidence capture -> decision funnel -> matched mentor + onboarding bundle -> 30/60/90 impact sprint -> calibration review.

1) Decision funnel (fast, evidence-first)
- Stage A: Phone screen (non-technical) — go/no-go within 48 hours. Criteria: role fit, communication, compensation alignment.
- Stage B: Technical interview loop (2–3 interviews) — each interviewer records a 6–8 bullet evidence note and numeric scores across 4 pillars.
- Stage C: Take-home / practical (optional for senior IC) — graded against acceptance thresholds.
- Stage D: Hiring committee or hiring manager sync — final recommendation (green/amber/red) with evidence snapshot.

Acceptance thresholds (example):
- Green: average pillar score >= 3.5/5 and no pillar < 3 AND strong evidence for at least 2 pillars.
- Amber: 3.0–3.5 average OR one pillar between 2.5–3.0 — requires manager-side risk mitigation plan and mentor pairing.
- Red: average < 3.0 OR clear behavioral/culture mismatch.

2) Interview rubric (single-page, used by every interviewer)
Scoring pillars (0–5 scale, integer allowed):
- Core Problem Solving (algorithmic/design thinking) — examples: choice of tradeoffs, edge-case reasoning.
- Role-Specific Craft (libraries, infra, model design, product thinking) — tailored per job template.
- Collaboration & Communication (clarity, feedback, async writing) — evidence: past PRs, docs.
- Learning & Growth Signals (curiosity, ramp examples, debug story) — evidence: side projects, previous ramps.

Each interviewer must provide:
- 6–8 short evidence bullets ("candidate did X, showed Y, unresolved Z")
- One recommended hire-path: hire-as-senior | hire-as-ic-level-adjusted | decline | hold-for-mentor-readiness
- Flag any policy/security/data concerns inline.

3) Evidence capture template (copy/paste into interview notes)
- 2 lines: role + date + interviewer
- 6 bullets: OBSERVED, NOT CLAIMED (facts only)
- 1 line: score by pillar (e.g., PS:4; Craft:3; Collab:5; Growth:4)
- 1 line: recommendation and suggested ramp tasks if amber

4) Manager decision meeting checklist (short)
- Read evidence snapshot from all interviewers
- Confirm acceptance threshold parity
- If amber: create concrete mitigation (mentor hours, stretch-first-30 tasks, weekly check-ins)
- Assign mentor curator to pick mentor and create first-week schedule
- For internal transfers: verify role overlap and ID skills to accelerate

5) Mentor curation process (people-ops + hiring manager)
- Purpose: match a mentor whose product/stack overlap is 60%+ and who has positive teaching history (ran onboarding, coached new ICs).
- Mentor scorecard: availability (hours/week), past mentee outcomes, area-of-expertise, communication style (paired/asynchronous).
- Seed list sources: previous onboard logs, SRE/eng leads recommended, internal mentor roster (Confluence maintained).
- Stipend: mentors get 4 hours/week protected for the first 4 weeks; manager approves.

6) Onboarding microflow (first 14 days checklist)
- Day 0: access + hardware + intro doc (people-ops owner)
- Day 1: manager 1:1, team AMA, assign buddy for first week (buddy ≠ mentor)
- Day 2–3: guided environment setup (sample runs, infra quick wins)
- Day 4–7: shadowing sessions with mentor, small scoped 1–2 day task to ship
- Week 2: first deliverable review, baseline telemetry access, schedule 30-day goals

7) 30/60/90 impact sprint template (to be filled by manager + mentor)
- 30 days: finish 1 scoped bug/feature, join oncall rotation readout, deliver doc summarizing system flow.
- 60 days: complete ownership of a subcomponent, reduce mean-time-to-change for a path by measurable metric.
- 90 days: independently ship a feature with rollout plan and postmortem.

Metric tracking (people-ops + manager):
- Ramp time (days to first merged PR with approvals)
- Time to independent deploy (days)
- Onboarding NPS (new hire survey at day 14 & day 60)
- Mentor feedback loop (weekly short form)

8) Amber hires: acceleration & risk plan (example)
- Pair hire with a mentor and require a 2-week "training deliverable" (outcome-based).
- Weekly manager/mentor review, escalate to hiring committee at 30 days if risk persists.
- Define kill-switch: if core craft score remains <3 after 60 days, convert to performance plan or role change.

9) Internal transfers & leveled adjustments
- Use interview rubric but allow manager to recommend leveled adjustment based on performance evidence in last 6 months and prior product impact.
- If leveled down: communicate explicitly (growth ladder tasks + timeline).

10) Practical templates (copyable)
- Interview evidence header: "Role | 2025-09-02 | Interviewer: NAME" + bullets + scores + recommendation
- Manager decision note: "Decision: GREEN/AMBER/RED. Rationale: ... Mitigations: ... Mentor: NAME (hours/week)."

11) Quick links & triggers
- Trigger hiring committee when any interviewer flags security/data concerns or when amber hires exceed 30% of offers in a quarter.
- Links: Confluence onboarding checklist (CONFLUENCE-ONBOARD-BASE), hiring funnel dashboard (JIRA-HIRE-DB).

12) Open questions / proposals for iteration
- Should we add a lightweight coding sandbox exercise that runs in-browser to standardize practicals? Pros: faster grading. Cons: infrastructure cost.
- Evaluate mentor stipend as a KPI (mentor load vs hire ramp time) next quarter.

Appendix: sample evidence bullet language (do/ don't)
- DO: "Implemented a breadth-first search variant to bound memory; explained edge-case for cycles; proposed tradeoff A vs B."
- DON'T: "Seems sharp, probably fine with system design."

Intended next steps (owner assignments)
- People-ops: publish final one-pager + short training for hiring managers (owner: Aisha Patel) — due 2025-09-30
- Eng managers: start using evidence template in next cycle (owner: Sofia Nguyen) — ongoing
- Hiring committee: review amber hire rate monthly and propose adjustments (owner: Marco Ruiz)

Notes to readers: This document is a working draft intended to be iterated after two full hiring cycles. Keep evidence factual and brief — hiring decisions should be reproducible from the notes alone.
